title: pythelpers
summary: A general-purpose collection of Python helper functions and utilities covering logging, file handling, and data transformation tasks. Its data_transformer module imports ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder directly from RDT to build a custom column transformer for tabular data preprocessing.
needs: Unclear if ClusterBasedNormalizer/OneHotEncoder are actually invoked elsewhere in the module or just imported; call sites not shown in evidence.
